text:
sam: Hey team — customer reported duplicate charges after our SDK retried a POST. They see 2 identical payloads hit our backend when network flapped briefly. Node 18 / undici@5.19.0 / @redwood/ts-sdk@1.4.2.

sam: Attached logs from their proxy: 
```
2026-03-10T15:03:12.123Z INFO req_id=abc123 POST /v1/complete 499 client-abort
2026-03-10T15:03:12.456Z INFO req_id=abc123 RETRY attempt=2 upstream-retry
2026-03-10T15:03:12.789Z INFO req_id=abc123 POST /v1/complete 200 ok
```

sam: They are using a streaming Readable as the body (multipart-ish). When the first request aborted we retried and it re-sent the same stream (so backend processed twice). Customer expects at-most-once.

priya: Thanks — can you paste the SDK call they're using? small snippet is fine.

sam: Yep, here's the minimal repro they gave: 
```ts
// Node 18, undici
const payloadStream = createSomeReadable(); // not rewindable
await client.request({
  method: 'POST',
  path: '/v1/complete',
  headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: payloadStream,
  retry: { maxAttempts: 3 }
});
```

sam: They said it only happens under intermittent network hiccups (timeout/499) and only with streaming bodies. Non-streaming (Buffer/JSON) is fine.

daniel: This matches an undici/Fetch semantics thing: when body is a stream it can't be replayed on retry unless you buffer it or recreate the stream. Our SDK previous retry implementation would call fetch again with the same Readable, which in Node will have been consumed. In some cases proxies/timeouts can lead to the server still reading the original request even though client aborted, so you end up with two server-side deliveries.

priya: Do we have a repro in-house? quick test I can run?

daniel: Yes — simple: spawn a server that intentionally delays reading until after client abort. Use a Readable that emits once. I reproduced locally:
```
# repro steps
1) node -v -> v18.17.1
2) npm i undici@5.19.0 @redwood/ts-sdk@1.4.2
3) run repro server that delays .on('data') handling
4) run client snippet with createSomeReadable() that pushes data then ends
5) simulate client network drop (short timeout) -> first request aborted but server still processes -> retry sends new stream -> duplicate
```

daniel: Log from my local run: 
```
client: attempt=1 aborted (timeout)
server: got-body for req_id=local-1 (after client timed out)
client: attempt=2 sent
server: processed req_id=local-1 (again)
```

priya: Ok. Two questions: 1) short-term mitigation for customers, 2) long-term SDK fix.

sam: Customer is asking for an immediate patch or config they can set.

daniel: Short-term options:
- Recommend they set an Idempotency-Key header on POSTs so backend can dedupe. (fast and reliable) :thumbsup:
- Ask them to not stream (buffer first into a Buffer/Blob) if payloads are small. Buffering enables safe retries.
- Reduce maxAttempts to 1 for streaming bodies and let them handle retries at app layer.

daniel: Long-term SDK fixes we discussed:
- Buffer the body automatically when it's a non-replayable stream if size <= X (configurable) and then retry using the buffer.
- Detect non-replayable bodies and skip automatic retries (or surface a clear warning).
- Add an option to provide a body factory (function) that's called per-attempt to create fresh streams.

priya: Which is less risky to ship quickly?

daniel: Add detection + disable automatic retries for non-replayable bodies by default (minor semver in behavior: safer). Then ship a follow-up that buffers small bodies (opt-in via config) or accepts a body factory.

sam: For the customer we recommended idempotency-key and reducing retries for streaming requests. I told them we'll cut an SDK patch to avoid auto-retries for non-replayable bodies.

support-bot: Created issue #INFR-782: "ts-sdk: avoid retries for non-replayable stream bodies; document idempotency guidance" assigned to eng-ml.

priya: Thanks. Dan — can you draft a short changelog blurb and a PR description for the patch? Keep it minimal: detect stream-like bodies and suppress retry with a clear error message if retry>1. Also add an example of bodyFactory in docs.

daniel: On it. Draft PR will:
- Add isReplayableBody helper (Buffer/Blob/string/URLSearchParams/ArrayBuffer are replayable)
- If not replayable and retry.maxAttempts > 1 -> set maxAttempts=1 and emit debug log + returned metadata warning in response.
- Tests: simulate undici aborted request with a one-time Readable and assert we don't send a second POST.

sam: Perfect. I'll follow-up with the customer with the idempotency workaround and ETA for SDK patch (24–48h).

priya: One more note: also call out Node versions — Node 20+ undici fetch clones body differently in some cases; include in the bug notes.

sam: Marking this resolved for now; will update the thread with PR link and customer confirmation. :white_check_mark:
